options.description: Asks with plain lines in and lines out rather than a region that redraws, for a screen reader: the question is written once, what is typed is echoed where it is typed, and nothing already written is ever moved or erased.
options.name: accessible

options.description: Whether Escape leaves the prompt to go back a step. Defaults to `false`, where Escape does nothing, as it always has.
options.name: back

options.description: What to offer, filtered by what is typed. Give this or `source`, not both. A choice marked `disabled` is left out, and a list of nothing else is refused the way an empty one is.
options.name: choices

options.description: The text the field starts with. Defaults to nothing.
options.name: initial

options.description: Shown dimmed when nothing has been typed.
options.name: placeholder

options.description: The input router to read keys through. One is built if not given.
options.name: router

options.description: How many rows the list may take. Defaults to what the terminal has left under the question.
options.default: what the terminal has left under the question
options.name: rows

options.description: Gives the prompt up when this aborts, the way Ctrl-C does.
options.name: signal

options.description: Looks the choices up instead of filtering a list. The result is shown as it is: the source is the filter, so nothing is re-ranked here.
options.name: source

options.description: Where keys come from. Defaults to the terminal's input.
options.name: stdin

options.description: Checks the chosen value. Return a string to refuse it with that message, or anything falsy to accept.
options.name: validate
options.type: (value: T) => string | undefined | false | Promise<string | undefined | false>

options.description: An answer to start from: the choice whose `value` this is starts highlighted in the first list on offer -- the one `choices` gives for `initial`, or what the source answers first. Compared the way a `Map` compares keys, and dropped when that list does not hold it or a key is pressed before it arrives.
options.name: value

registryDescription: autocomplete() and autocompleteMultiselect(): type to filter a list, or search an async source
